prompt: Compose one complete original 30-second instrumental promotional score. Sound: brisk bossa nova with clipped sunny guitar answers. Instruments: nylon guitar, rim clicks, upright bass, shaker. Tempo 108 BPM. Distinct motif: two staccato notes and an octave leap. Immediate catchy hook and clear beat at 00:00, with no slow introduction. Maintain a strong compact groove from every downbeat, suitable for a 25-second lifestyle film. Use short two-bar melodic gestures, crisp edit accents, mobile-speaker-friendly midrange and space for narration. Vary the timbre halfway through while keeping the pulse. Keep the musical hook and full groove active until the last two seconds. At 00:28, play a decisive resolving tonic button, followed by less than one second of natural decay, then end completely. No fade-out, extended outro, breakdown, long riser or silent gap. Punchy and tuneful, never harsh. Instrumental only. No vocals, choir, humming, singing, speech, lyrics or vocal samples. Do not imitate any artist, existing song or brand jingle.
